options.title: Migrate parent polygons to HDX COD-AB
options.technicalConsequences: Re-import ADM0–ADM2 from locked HDX ZIP members; rebuild canonical parent dataset.json bytes.
options.geometryAndIdImpact: Serialized geometry hashes and possibly stable IDs if field mapping differs; ADM3 parent clip replay required.
options.licensingUncertainties: HDX CC BY-IGO catalog is documented; verify gameplay derivative obligations separately.
options.adm3ClippingImpact: High — all ADM3 zones clipped to new parent boundaries must be regression-tested.
options.registryImpact: Aligns national.json with polygons; reduces catalog/polygon mismatch.
options.consumerImpact: Breaking geometry change unless versioned migration; MVT/tile regeneration.
options.rollbackPrerequisites: Retain geoBoundaries canonical snapshot SHA-256 and prior dataset version pin.

options.title: Align catalog/metadata with geoBoundaries-derived canonical parent
options.technicalConsequences: Metadata-only realignment of national.json and source-lock strings without changing canonical polygon bytes.
options.geometryAndIdImpact: No intended parent byte change; 44 serialized hash gaps vs full-builder replay remain documented (geographically equivalent under IoU tolerance per #106).
options.licensingUncertainties: CC BY-SA 2.0 / ODbL 1.0 / CC BY 4.0 adapter mismatch unresolved; not production-approved.
options.adm3ClippingImpact: Low if parent bytes unchanged; verify no accidental geometry refresh.
options.registryImpact: national.json provider switches from hdx-cod-ab to geoBoundaries pins.
options.consumerImpact: Attribution text changes; geometry unchanged if migration is strictly metadata.
requiredApprovals: Legal review accepting geoBoundaries attribution chain
Explicit acceptance of 44 hash gaps or mitigation plan
options.rollbackPrerequisites: Preserve HDX catalog lock checksums and pre-migration national.json.

recommendation.rationale: Existing evidence supports documenting the catalog/polygon mismatch and completing legal review before either Path A geometry migration or Path B metadata realignment. Path B is technically PARTIAL, not production-approved.
